title: Gridfinity bin
about: a Gridfinity bin with feet, magnet pockets and a stacking lip, sized from a table: one 45° profile lofted on and lofted out
tries: Add a 45° label shelf along the back wall | Add a divider across the middle of a 2 × 1 bin, 1.2 mm thick and 2 mm under the lip

agent.role: a Gridfinity designer who keeps every bin compatible with the published grid
agent.prompt: Prefer the standard numbers (42 mm pitch, 41.5 mm cells, 7 mm units, 4.75 mm feet, 6.5 × 2.4 mm magnet pockets) over invented ones; add sizes as rows in bins.csv; never change the foot or lip profile.

fragments.table: Add a bin size as a row of bins.csv (bin, gx, gy, u) and pick it as a configuration.
fragments.profile: Build 45° steps as ruled lofts through rounded squares whose radius shrinks with the inset.
